annotations.title: Get the signed-in user's saved searches on homes.com

description: The signed-in user's saved searches on homes.com. Scrapes /customer/dashboard/saved-searches/. Returns `{ count, searches: [{ name?, url, filters? }] }`. REQUIRES the user to be signed into homes.com in their browser tab — if not, the request throws SessionNotAuthenticatedError. `name` and `filters` are DOM-scraped from the saved-search card; absence means homes.com didn't render them, not that the search has none. Read-only; safe to call repeatedly.
name: homes_get_saved_searches
title: Get the signed-in user's saved searches on homes.com
